intro: This quest sends Alliance adventurers north along the coast of Darkshore to sift through the overgrown Ruins of Mathystra. Onu, an Ancient of Lore rooted in the Grove of the Ancients, seeks these ancient kaldorei artifacts to understand how the Twilight's Hammer cult is manipulating night elven sorcery for their sinister rites.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The parchment you found at the Master's Glaive is a page from an ancient text...written by elves! It is heavily cursed and tainted by the corruption of the Twilight's Hammer, but it seems the cult is using ancient elven magic to bring their old masters back to our world.

Travel to the ruins of Mathystra to the northeast, and search for ancient relics among the grass and broken stones. Through their study, we may divine how the Twilight's Hammer intends to exploit the magic of the elves.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you. These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone. That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain. Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...
